```{r, results="hide", echo=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error=FALSE)
if (!exists(".version")) {
    .version <- package_version("1.0")
}
```

```{r, results="asis", echo=FALSE}
cat("# Single cell experiment (", as.character(.version), ")", sep="")
```

## Overview

The `single_cell_experiment` format provides an on-disk representation of a single cell experiment. 
It is based on the `SingleCellExperiment` class from the [**SingleCellExperiment** bioconductor package](https://bioconductor.org/packages/SingleCellExperiment).

The `single_cell_experiment` format is derived from the [`ranged_summarized_experiment` format](../ranged_summarized_experiment).
It can be used anywhere that a `ranged_summarized_experiment` is expected.

## Metadata

The `OBJECT` file should contain a `single_cell_experiment` property, which is itself a JSON object with the following properties:

- `version`, a string specifying the version of the `single_cell_experiment` format.
```{r, results="asis", echo=FALSE}
cat("  This should be set to \"", as.character(.version), "\".", sep="")
```
- (optional) `main_experiment_name`, a string containing the name of the main experiment.
  If provided, this should not overlap with any names of the alternative experiments in the `alternative_experiments` subdirectory.

In addition, the `OBJECT` file should contain all properties expected of the [`ranged_summarized_experiment`](../ranged_summarized_experiment) format. 

## Directory structure

### Contents

The directory should contain:

- `OBJECT`, a JSON file as described above.
- All files expected of the [`ranged_summarized_experiment`](../ranged_summarized_experiment) format.

Optionally, it may also contain:

- `reduced_dimensions/`, a subdirectory.
- `alternative_experiments/`, a subdirectory.

### `reduced_dimensions/`

The subdirectory should contain a `names.json` file, which contains a JSON-formatted array of strings.
Each string is the name of a dimensionality reduction result in the single cell experiment.
Each string should be non-empty and unique.

Each dimensionality reduction result should be represented by a subdirectory of `reduced_dimensions/`, named after its position in the array of names in `reduced_dimensions/names.json`.
That is, the `i`-th dimensionality reduction result should be represented by the subdirectory `reduced_dimensions/i/`.
Each subdirectory should be a child object that has some concept of dimensions, most typically a `dense_array` object.
The extent of the first dimension should be equal to the [number of columns of the single cell experiment](#dimensions).

Aside from `names.json` and the dimensionality result subdirectories, no other files or directories should be present in the `reduced_dimensions/` subdirectory.
The exception is that of files/directories prefixed with `.` or `_`, which are ignored.

Note that any row names in any subdirectory of `reduced_dimensions/` should not be used as the column names of the ranged summarized experiment, 
as this is determined from the `summarized_experiment`-based files instead.

If no `reduced_dimensions/` subdirectory is present, it is assumed that the single cell experiment contains no reduced dimensions.

### `alternative_experiments/`

The subdirectory should contain a `names.json` file, which contains a JSON-formatted array of strings.
Each string is the name of an alternative experiment of the single cell experiment.
Each string should be non-empty and unique.

Each alternative experiment should be represented by a subdirectory of `alternative_experiments/`, named after its position in the array of names in `alternative_experiments/names.json`.
That is, the `i`-th alternative experiment should be represented by the subdirectory `alternative_experiments/x/`.
Each subdirectory should be a child object that satisfies the `SUMMARIZED_EXPERIMENT` interface.
The number of columns of each alternative experiment should equal to the [number of columns of the single cell experiment](#dimensions).

Note that any column names in any subdirectory of `alternative_experiments/` should not be used as the column names of the ranged summarized experiment, 
as this is determined from the `summarized_experiment`-based files instead.

Aside from `names.json` and the alternative experiment subdirectories, no other files or directories should be present in the `alternative_experiments/` subdirectory.
The exception is that of files/directories prefixed with `.` or `_`, which are ignored.

If no `alternative_experiments/` subdirectory is present, it is assumed that the single cell experiment contains no alternative experiments.

## Height

The height of the single cell experiment is defined in the same manner as that of its base [summarized experiment](../summarized_experiment).

## Dimensions

The dimensions of the single cell experiment is defined in the same manner as that of its base [summarized experiment](../summarized_experiment).

## Interfaces

The `single_cell_experiment` satisfies the `SUMMARIZED_EXPERIMENT` interface.
